status: Fixed before CODE10 reliability calculations and refit diagnostics; all CODE8/CODE9 outcomes already known.
question: Do weak cross-genotype gene-gain associations remain after accounting for target-pool repeatability and under disjoint full-refit partitions?
scope: Post-result diagnostic, not a new external validation or a change to original CODE8 predictions.
scale: log2(1+author FPKM); squared error difference; no additional normalization.
immutable_parent_rule: Verify all pins, retain original assets/panels/predictions unchanged. Separate diagnostic refits never overwrite CODE8 or CODE9.

part_A.predictors: Original frozen CODE8 primary predictions, common features only for summaries.
part_A.moment_convention: H centers each vector across the finite common feature universe; inner product divides by G, not an independent-gene sampling assumption.
part_A.stable_variance: Vstable=Vobs-Nmean; exact equivalent sum_{j!=k}(Hdelta_j dot Hdelta_k)/[n(n-1)G]
part_A.conditional_reliability: Vstable/Vobs when Vobs>0, retain negatives and flag. No clipping.
part_A.cross_genotype: C=Hmean_delta_Car dot Hmean_delta_Cleo/G; raw Pearson and Spearman; adjustedPearson=C/sqrt(VstableCar*VstableCleo) only when both strictly positive.
part_A.ratio_limits: AdjustedPearson is a plug-in moment ratio, not unbiased; retain values beyond [-1,1] and flag. No correction of Spearman.
part_A.within_pairs: All three target-pool pair Pearson/Spearman values per genotype/comparator, no P values.
part_A.assumptions: Stable conditional means, zero-mean pool-specific errors uncorrelated across repeats and genotypes; arbitrary within-pool cross-gene covariance allowed.
part_A.limits: RNA-pool variability includes biological and technical components. Shared predictor fitting errors and shared preprocessing remain; stable components need not be biological truth.

part_B.draw_rule: Uniform choice of 256 unique complete base3 codes without replacement independently by genotype; index_i=(code//3**i)%3 in fixed condition order.
part_B.sides: One chosen pool per condition on side1, complementary two on side2. Computational draw pair is not an experimental matched block.
part_B.fitting: Each side separately fits its own CT, single and pair means using FULL original genotype primary panel; target excluded from fitting. Same CODE8 SVD tolerance eps*max(shape)*largest singular value and np.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None). No refilter or new coefficient constraints.
part_B.models: D=C+mean(pair-C); second=C+sum(pair-C)-sum(single-C); withinV3=C+P_single(D-C); factorOLS uses three factor-masked single columns stacked over three pairs, no intercept.
part_B.scoring: Align full-panel predictions and side-specific target observations to common feature IDs. Per-gene gain equals gain against target mean. Report absolute MSE averaged over target pools, with convention explicit.
part_B.top_rule: Exactly ceil(0.10*15466), descending mean gain with lexical Feature_GID ties, no positive-gain restriction.
part_B.matched_contrast: Per draw and metric, mean(Car1_Car2,Cleo1_Cleo2)-mean(Car1_Cleo2,Car2_Cleo1). Unavailable if any required value unavailable.
part_B.summary: Each metric/contrast: finite count, min, q0.025, median, q0.975, max; arithmetic quantiles method linear. These overlapping-partition distributions are sensitivity ranges, NOT confidence intervals or independent experiments.
part_B.saved: Exact partitions/sample names; per-draw pair metrics and contrasts; side/condition identities; coefficients/ranks; side MSE and gain; failure/degeneracy flags; source/code/runtime hashes. No huge per-draw gene arrays necessary.
part_B.limits: Only 3 pools per condition; sides 1 vs2; shared full-data feature selection and author preprocessing remain. Within/cross differences do not identify causal genotype effects or remove all noise.

unavailable_rule: Constant centered vector -> unavailable correlation, never zero. Nonpositive stable variance -> unavailable adjustedPearson. Preserve explicit reasons and failed fits; no silent deletion.
selftests: zero/negative stable variance and zero-norm flags
all-pool reconstruction of existing CODE8 primary predictions
inference: No gene-level P values, gene bootstrap, RNA-replicate claims from feature count, calibrated CIs, new success cutoff or predictor retuning.
claim_boundary: Aggregate prediction accuracy and gene attribution reliability are separate. Persistently weaker between-genotype associations support an observed attribution difference under this diagnostic, not a shared/different causal pathway mechanism.
resource_plan: Single BLAS thread, existing Python; no network/download/install needed for calculation.
